name: std::same_as

declarations.code:
template <class T, class U>

concept same_as = /* see below */;

intro:
The concept same_as<T, U> is satisfied if and only if T and U denote the same type.

std::same_as<T, U> subsumes std::same_as<U, T> and vice versa.
